item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We are building toward that future.

2. We see superintelligence as a turning point for prosperity. If it is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double in the following decade. We are working to turn that potential into progress.

3. We are building AI to accelerate science, medicine, and economic growth. Our position is clear: if superintelligence arrives within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We are building toward that future because faster scientific discovery, better medicine, and greater productive capacity are worth pursuing with urgency. We see superintelligence as a foundation for prosperity on a scale the world has never experienced. We also recognise the responsibility that comes with developing it. We believe the United States must lead, and we work to protect the frontier research that makes progress possible. Our ambition is straightforward: build intelligence that expands what humanity can discover, create, and achieve.
